name: RealPref
intro: RealPref 是一个面向长期个性化用户-LLM 交互的偏好遵循评测基准，覆盖显式与隐式偏好表达、长时程交互历史以及未见场景下的偏好泛化能力。
build_method: 100个用户画像, 1300个个性化偏好, 四种偏好表达, 长时程交互历史
task_type: 偏好遵循, 个性化问答
eval_feature: 四种偏好表达, 长时程交互历史, 未见场景泛化
intro_en: RealPref evaluates long-horizon preference following in personalized user-LLM interactions with both explicit and implicit preference signals.
build_method_en: 100 user profiles, 1,300 personalized preferences, four preference-expression types, long-horizon interaction histories
eval_feature_en: Four Preference Expression Types, Long-horizon Interaction Histories, Unseen-scenario Generalization

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2603.04191 Sections 3-4, cross-checked against GG14127/RealPref generation pipeline and dataset schema. RealPref samples and manually filters 100 PersonaHub personas, extends them with demographics, biographies, and life events, and creates ten original plus three rationally inferred generalized preferences per user for 1,300 preferences. Each preference is expressed through four modes ranging from explicit to implicit. Preference, life-event, and random sessions are concatenated into histories averaging roughly 2K to 247K tokens. Original and generalized preferences receive multiple-choice, true-or-false, and open-ended queries. Classification tasks use accuracy, while open answers are judged against granular rubrics; results are sliced by expression type, context length, and unseen-scenario generalization.
